channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: docs.anthropic.com: Claude Code CLI
item.description: [CRITICAL] Anthropic's official CLI agent sets a benchmark for autonomous terminal-based codebase refactoring and software engineering.

item.title: cursor.com: Cursor AI Code Editor
item.description: [CRITICAL] Acts as the flagship AI-native development environment driving broad enterprise transition to agentic programming workflows.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane revolutionizes infrastructure management by transforming Kubernetes into a universal, declarative multi-cloud control plane.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the essential foundational layer for scheduling and running modern AI/ML and GPU-accelerated workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Defines the production standard for hosting high-performance, memory-efficient LLM inference workloads on Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: Tetragon (Cilium)
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides real-time kernel-level runtime enforcement and security observability for Kubernetes using eBPF.

item.title: ==dagger/dagger: Dagger is a portable devkit for CICD==
item.description: [CRITICAL] Dagger introduces a paradigm shift in CI/CD by replacing brittle DSLs with programmable, BuildKit-backed pipelines in general-purpose languages.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the industry standard open-source service mesh control plane powering zero-trust mTLS and dynamic traffic routing.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the core production-standard engine for dynamic node elasticity and cluster autoscaling across all major cloud providers.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 provides the foundational GitOps Toolkit controllers powering decoupled, automated reconciliation across enterprise Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] Represents the foundational, de facto cloud-native telemetry and alerting standard powering metric collection across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational CNCF-graduated container runtime powering modern Kubernetes clusters and production container workloads.

item.title: runc
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the canonical OCI reference low-level container runtime executing Linux cgroups and namespace isolation.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] Acts as the standard enterprise backbone for dynamic secrets management and zero-trust identity brokering.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the vendor-agnostic industry standard pipeline for collecting, processing, and exporting distributed traces, metrics, and logs across cloud-native environments.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] Defines the official next-generation specification superseding Ingress with role-oriented, expressive service routing APIs.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] Velero is the essential open-source standard for backing up, migrating, and recovering Kubernetes cluster workloads and persistent volumes.

item.title: OpenTofu 1.12: the Feature Terraform Never Shipped
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces landmark language capabilities to OpenTofu that resolve long-standing upstream Terraform architectural limitations.

item.title: New in Terraform 1.15: Dynamic sources, variable deprecation, and more
item.description: [CRITICAL] Delivers major enterprise enhancements to core Terraform including native dynamic module sources and modernized variable handling.

item.title: The Agentic Infrastructure Era
item.description: [CRITICAL] Defines a major paradigm shift in IaC toward autonomous, self-healing, and LLM agent-driven platform provisioning.
